headline: An Active Bengaluru-named restaurant card carries Andhra-food copy and a Call Now action; calls and outcomes are not public.
market_signal: The selected Meta card appears under United Telugu Kitchens Bengaluru, uses Andhra-food and Bengaluru copy, and displays Call now. The brand's contact page lists Kadugodi and Kanakapura Bengaluru locations. Its only published email found for this record is on the separate Catering page and is explicitly for catering enquiries, not paid media.

findings.title: The Call now card is a public CTA, not a measured call or restaurant visit
findings.evidence: Meta Library ID 1400576771684831; United Telugu Kitchens Bengaluru; Active and Sponsored on 06 Oct 2026; started 03 Oct 2026. Copy refers to Andhra food/Bengaluru and the card shows Call now.
findings.analysis: The video did not play in the capture. The visible page, text and CTA are supported; the call destination, calls, dining visits, orders and campaign performance were not measured.
findings.next_check: Re-open the card and call path; if authorized, agree whether the intended outcome is a connected call, qualified enquiry, visit or another event before measuring it.

findings.title: Bengaluru locations are first-party; the available email route is catering-specific
findings.evidence: The official Contact page lists Kadugodi and Kanakapura Bengaluru locations. The official Catering page publishes gm@telugukitchens.com for catering enquiries.
findings.analysis: The sources establish local food-service context and a related published email, not that this inbox owns restaurant media or paid campaigns.
findings.next_check: If using the catering inbox, ask it to route the note to the correct marketing/media owner; for broader outreach, confirm an appropriate published general route first.
